text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy's running showed promise of what was to come.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, she's pretty good.
Still a bit rough around the edges, but she's got tons of momentum.
I'm looking forward to seeing what she does next~.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah-hah!
Right, right?!
Windy-chan is amazing, isn't she~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... Everyone's looking this way. We're definitely gonna be flooded with interview requests!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh???
Are there really no other articles about Windy-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All I got was a tiny headshot in the corner of a magazine
labeled as a 'Rookie to Watch'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And only a single magazine at that.
It's only natural since it's just her debut race, but...
it must be frustrating for someone who wants to stand out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Unuuu... This is weird... It's pissing me off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even though I ran so aggressively
that my legs are still throbbing even now...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? Something like this will be cured after a good night's sleep.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! Windy-chan wants
everyone to pay more attention to herrーーー!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
we're going to run in even bigger races.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's gonna show the whole world
how amazing she is!"
choice_data_list: Before that, let's head to the infirmary for a bit.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
...It seems you haven't fully shaken off
the fatigue from the race.
It's not severe enough to visit a hospital, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Thaaat's why I said "sleep and you'll get better."
What a troublesome minion you are.
choice_data_list: No, I can't overlook this sign.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has only just begun her growth phase.
Overworking her legs right now could put too much strain on them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A young Umamusume's legs are delicate while growing.
Straining them with excessive training risks causing
"bucked shins"—periostitis.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Periostitis...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: D-Does that mean... my bones... something's gonna happen to my bones?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-N-N-Nooo, anything that hurts is a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuugh... Even though I finally made my debut... to think I can't run all-out...!
choice_data_list: You have to make sure not to overwork yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained the risk of injury from overexertion.
And that it would be best to hold off on rushing into
hard races for a little while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it's not as if racing is entirely forbidden.
So, for now, we'll take it easy...
choice_data_list: Let's get your body warmed up while we gain more fans!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fans?
choice_data_list: Right, first we need to get your name out there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Name rec... recognition...! I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Is that why no one's interviewing
Windy-chan?!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... even in my debut race,
everyone said 'that kid is amazing', but nobody
ever called me 'Windy'!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe~... First, raise my profile
and get more Windy-chan fans.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And on top of that... you'll blow everyone away with an overwhelming run and make them eat their words, huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That is quite a splendid strategy! Minion...
Nay, Evil Chief of Staff! I shall praise you~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Ghehe~! Magazines! News! Every living room in the nation will be overflowing with talk about Windy-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she agreed to take it easy for a while
until her legs were fully conditioned.
Until then, let's focus on gathering fans!
